study-daa0754982a18d2768b5.title: Meat
study-daa0754982a18d2768b5.rationale: National Geographic supports the common mammal-focused usage, nutrients and cultural differences; USDA supports ingredients and processing of plant-based alternatives; FDA supports the separate animal-cell process. The draft handles the conventional versus alternative distinction well.

issues.claim: The key distinction is the source—plants or animal cells—not simply how meat-like a product looks or tastes.
issues.problem: The two-way shorthand omits fungi despite the preceding sentence and the cited USDA report expressly including fungi among ingredients for plant-based alternatives. Fungi are not plants, so a literal reading is incomplete.
issues.suggested_correction: Say “plant or fungal ingredients versus cultured animal cells,” or refer to “non-animal ingredients versus animal cells.”
